description:
Deploy the Javadoc archive for Apache Commons Lang 3 to the 'example-repo-local' repository. 

1. Locate the file 'commons-lang3-javadoc.jar' on the Desktop.
2. In the Artifactory UI, deploy this file to 'example-repo-local'.
3. Configure the deployment with the Target Path 'javadocs/commons-lang3'.
4. CRITICAL: You must enable the 'Explode this archive' option during deployment so that the contents are extracted.
5. Deploy the artifact.

When finished, the path 'example-repo-local/javadocs/commons-lang3' should contain the extracted HTML files (e.g., index.html), not just the JAR file.
